params.name: elementRef
params.description: XML element reference at which the search starts

params.name: xPath
params.description: XPath expression identifying the element(s) to look for

params.name: arrElementRefs
params.description: Receives the list of all matching element references, useful when several elements match xPath

overloads.semanticRole: Searches an XML structure, starting at elementRef, for element(s) matching an XPath expression, returning the (first) match's reference and optionally all matches.

constraints: When arrElementRefs is passed and filled, the command's function-result return value is the first element of that array.
